about: Fictional sample team used by `meetingmind dashboard --sample` and the live demo. Items listed under done (by index in each meeting's extracted action items) are marked done.

meetings.title: Weekly sync
meetings.transcript:
[00:00:00] Priya: Morning everyone. Quick weekly sync on the onboarding dashboard. Where are we on the churn numbers?
[00:00:09] Marcus: The query is done but the numbers look off for October. I'll rerun the cohort query with the fixed timezone by Friday.
[00:00:21] Priya: Great. Dana, can you send the customer the updated CSV export spec?
[00:00:27] Dana: Yes. I can also draft the FAQ for the support team by next week.
[00:00:35] Marcus: One concern is the API rate limit. We keep hitting 429s on the nightly sync.
[00:00:44] Priya: Okay, we decided to batch the sync into 500-record pages. Action item: Marcus to add retry with backoff to the sync job.
[00:00:56] Dana: Do we have a date for the customer demo?
[00:01:01] Priya: Let's go with Tuesday. I will book the room and send the invite tomorrow.
[00:01:10] Marcus: Sounds good.
[00:01:13] Priya: Thanks all, see you next week.

meetings.title: Web standup
meetings.transcript:
[00:00:00] Ann: Yesterday I shipped the signup form. Today I'll fix the login redirect bug.
[00:00:08] Bo: I'm blocked on the staging database. Ann, can you share the staging credentials with me?
[00:00:16] Ann: Sure, I'll send them after this call.
[00:00:20] Cara: I will review Bo's pull request by end of day.
[00:00:26] Bo: Thanks. That's all from me.

meetings.title: Weekly sync
meetings.transcript:
[00:00:00] Priya: Morning. The churn dashboard went out on Friday and the customer liked it.
[00:00:10] Marcus: The retry change cut the 429 errors on the nightly sync. I'll write up the incident notes by Wednesday.
[00:00:24] Priya: Good. Dana, can you check the October cohort numbers against finance by Thursday?
[00:00:33] Dana: Yes. I'll also update the data dictionary for the new churn fields.
[00:00:41] Priya: We decided to move the demo to next Tuesday. Action item: Marcus to prepare the demo dataset by next monday.
[00:00:55] Marcus: Sounds good.
[00:00:58] Priya: Thanks all.

meetings.title: Sprint planning
meetings.transcript:
[00:00:00] Cara: Let's plan the sprint. The big item is the new billing page.
[00:00:12] Cara: I'll break the billing page into tickets by tomorrow.
[00:00:18] Bo: I can build the invoice table component by Friday.
[00:00:26] Cara: Ann, can you add the Stripe webhook handler by next week?
[00:00:33] Ann: Yes. We should also fix the flaky checkout test.
[00:00:40] Cara: Agreed. Bo will fix the flaky checkout test.
[00:00:46] Bo: Okay.
[00:00:49] Ann: What about the dark mode request?
[00:00:53] Cara: Let's go with next sprint for dark mode.
[00:01:00] Cara: Thanks everyone, good planning.

meetings.title: Customer review
meetings.transcript:
[00:00:00] Priya: Thanks for joining. The goal today is to review the onboarding metrics with the customer team.
[00:00:15] Priya: The activation rate chart is the one they asked about most.
[00:00:24] Marcus: The chart uses the fixed timezone now, so October matches finance.
[00:00:33] Priya: Great. They also want weekly exports. Dana, can you set up the weekly export job by Nov 12?
[00:00:45] Dana: Yes, that works.
[00:00:48] Marcus: I'll add a data freshness check to the export.
[00:00:55] Priya: Okay, final call: we ship weekly exports first and daily later.
[00:01:03] Priya: Thanks, that's it.

meetings.title: Weekly sync
meetings.transcript:
[00:00:00] Priya: Quick sync. Where are we on the weekly export?
[00:00:06] Dana: It's half done. The schema changed, so I need another day or two.
[00:00:14] Priya: Okay. Marcus, can you pair with Dana on the export schema by tomorrow?
[00:00:22] Marcus: Yes. I'll also draft the runbook for the export job by end of week.
[00:00:31] Priya: I will send the customer a status update today.
[00:00:37] Dana: Sounds good.

meetings.title: Web standup
meetings.transcript:
[00:00:00] Ann: The webhook handler is done and in review.
[00:00:05] Bo: The invoice table slipped. I'll finish the invoice table by Thursday.
[00:00:12] Cara: Okay. I'll ask design for the empty state mockups.
[00:00:18] Ann: Cara, can you approve my webhook pull request today?
[00:00:24] Cara: Yes, after lunch.
[00:00:27] Bo: That's all from me.

meetings.title: Retro
meetings.transcript:
[00:00:00] Cara: Retro time. What went well?
[00:00:05] Ann: Webhooks shipped on time and the tests are solid.
[00:00:12] Bo: The invoice table took longer than planned because the design changed twice.
[00:00:22] Cara: Agreed, we need the design locked before we start. I'll add a design sign-off step to the ticket template.
[00:00:35] Bo: I will write down the estimate for each ticket before we start.
[00:00:42] Ann: I'll pair with Bo on the remaining invoice table work tomorrow.
[00:00:50] Cara: Thanks all.
